name: clean-arch
description: Turn agent-grown Python code into a readable architecture with an explicit spine, dataclass contracts, flat 3-layer modules, interactive side-pane review, leftover gates, and 4+1 SVG docs.
suggestedPrompts: /clean-arch 对当前仓库做完整架构诊断、两轮重构与文档沉淀
/arch-diagnose 只读诊断当前仓库的主干脉络、隐式字典与层级违规
/arch-map 生成或更新 4+1 架构文档与自包含 SVG 图表
/perf-tune 基于火焰图与 Peak RSS 剖析优化耗时或内存占用
